admission.justification: Records the by-design appendix row-62 validator choice so future validator work keeps it.

alternatives.option: Exclude history-row IDs from tree-wide uniqueness while keeping record, realization and proof IDs tree-wide unique and history-file shape/freeze checks intact.
alternatives.reason: Two closed history files cannot be repaired to remove a repeated row ID: their bytes are frozen. The validator therefore omits history rows from the cross-tree identity holders, and the index independently addresses a row by(path,id).

alternatives.option: Require history-row IDs to be tree-wide unique, including row IDs already held in separate closed history files.
alternatives.reason: Repairing such a duplicate would require rewriting one of the closed files, contradicting the history-freeze contract.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An approved revision changes the closed-history immutability contract and supplies a repair route for previously frozen duplicate IDs.

consequences: Future validation keeps history-row shape and closed-file preservation without admitting history rows into cross-tree ID uniqueness.
The independent index(path,id) choice and every previously credited scope remain unchanged.
context: MIK-R74 row62(part), read with MIK-R54 row62: history-row IDs are outside tree-wide uniqueness. This is distinct from the already-credited index(path,id) lookup choice, which remains unchanged.
